stem: A seed population produced from the same cross shows a wide range of traits. Which explanation is most consistent with basic inheritance?
choices: Segregating alleles and recombination can create variation among siblings
Siblings from the same cross may differ mainly because environmental conditions rewrite which parental alleles each seed inherits during development
The maternal parent usually contributes most inherited variation, so broad differences among siblings primarily indicate variation in the female parent
A wide range of traits is strongest evidence that the recorded parentage is unreliable because siblings from known parents should remain genetically similar
rationale: Sexually produced siblings can differ because parental alleles segregate and recombine into different combinations.
